claims.summary: Fix a binary monic d(z) of degree b>=0 and nu>=b. Given a shared binary division-free unbounded-fanin circuit, gate/wire size S and depth delta, for the COMPLETE coefficient list a0(y),...,a_nu(y) of g=sum a_i z^i, with d|g in F2[y,z], h=g/d has circuit size O(S+(nu+1)^2), depth<=delta+3. Put u=nu-b,d*=t^b d(1/t), and let c_l be the t^l coefficient of 1/d* for l<=u, fixed binary constants; h_j=sum_(l<=u-j)c_l a_(b+j+l), reconstruct h=sum h_j z^j using ordinary power wires. Nonzero g has actual joint degree deg h=deg g-b. Fixed nonuniform divisor and degree parameters, not variable inputs. No coefficient access from an implicit g circuit, PC-degree transfer, proof-image inclusion, binary general quotient algorithm or Frege advance is supplied.
